import bpy,bmesh,math,json
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15'];root=ns['root'];cap=ns['cap'];craft=ns['craft']
assert craft.get('work15_surfaces') and not craft.get('work15_roof')
archive=bpy.data.collections.new('Archive_ShipyardWorking_20261115');bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(archive);archive.hide_viewport=True;archive.hide_render=True
retired=[]
for o in list(craft.objects):
 if o.name.startswith(('Steel monitor cap','Steel monitor drip','Combined_rear_B monitor end','Combined_rear_B skylight glazing bar','Combined_rear_B skylight crossbar')):
  archive.objects.link(o);craft.objects.unlink(o);retired.append(o.name)
iron=bpy.data.materials['SP13_ForgedEdgeIron'];roof=bpy.data.materials['M15_RoofWeatheredSteel']
def recalc(me):
 bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(me);bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces));bm.to_mesh(me);bm.free();me.update()
def projected_uv(me):
 uv=me.uv_layers.active or me.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
 for p in me.polygons:
  axis=max(range(3),key=lambda i:abs(p.normal[i]));i,j=([1,2] if axis==0 else [0,2] if axis==1 else [0,1])
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   q=me.vertices[me.loops[li].vertex_index].co;uv.data[li].uv=(q[i]/1.4,q[j]/1.4)
def mesh(name,vs,fs,mat,tag):
 me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name);me.from_pydata(vs,[],fs);me.materials.append(mat);me.update()
 ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me);craft.objects.link(ob);ob[tag]=True;return ob
profile=[(-.761,7.544),(-.760,7.578),(-.715,7.591),(0,7.791),(.715,7.591),(.760,7.578),(.761,7.544)]
panels=[]
for j in range(5):
 a=3.25+j*.944;b=min(7.973,a+.961);lift=j*.0007
 vs=[(x,y,z+lift) for y in [a,b] for x,z in profile];L=len(profile)
 fs=[(i,i+1,i+1+L,i+L) for i in range(L-1)]
 ob=mesh('W15 folded monitor sheet '+str(j),vs,fs,roof,'work15_sheet');me=ob.data
 uv=me.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
 for p in me.polygons:
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   q=me.vertices[me.loops[li].vertex_index].co
   side=1 if sum(me.vertices[vi].co.x for vi in p.vertices)>=0 else -1
   uv.data[li].uv=((.04 if side>0 else .54)+(q.y-3.25)/4.723*.40,.003+abs(q.x)/.761*.176)
 so=ob.modifiers.new('Thin folded sheet steel','SOLIDIFY');so.thickness=.006;so.offset=-1;so.use_rim=True
 panels.append(ob.name)
# Thin formed end closures follow the cap profile rather than protruding square bars.
ends=[]
for j,y in enumerate([3.279,7.945]):
 vs=[(x,Y,z) for Y in [y-.006,y+.006] for x,z in [(-.70,7.584),(0,7.782),(.70,7.584)]]
 o=mesh('W15 monitor formed end '+str(j),vs,[(0,2,1),(3,4,5),(0,1,4,3),(1,2,5,4),(2,0,3,5)],iron,'work15_closed');recalc(o.data);projected_uv(o.data);ends.append(o.name)
# Reduce kerb section but retain existing laps, roof holes and alignment.
curbs=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.name.startswith('Steel skylight cross curb'):
  o.data=o.data.copy()
  for v in o.data.vertices:v.co.y*=.56;v.co.z*=.65
  normal=o.matrix_world.to_3x3()@Vector((0,0,1));o.location-=normal*.023
  curbs.append(o.name)
 elif o.name.startswith('Steel skylight side curb'):
  o.data=o.data.copy()
  for v in o.data.vertices:v.co.x*=.62;v.co.z*=.65
  o.location.z-=.030;curbs.append(o.name)
for n in curbs:
 o=bpy.data.objects[n];o.data.update();o['work15_slim_curb']=True
 for md in o.modifiers:
  if md.type=='BEVEL':md.width=min(md.width,.003)
S=Vector((1,0,-.52)).normalized();N=Vector((.52,0,1)).normalized();Y=Vector((0,1,0))
section=[(-.013,.024),(.013,.024),(.013,.016),(.004,.016),(.004,.002),(-.004,.002),(-.004,.016),(-.013,.016)]
bars=[]
def tbar(name,A,B,cross):
 vs=[tuple(P+cross*u+N*v) for P in [A,B] for u,v in section];L=len(section)
 fs=[tuple(reversed(range(L))),tuple(range(L,2*L))]+[(i,(i+1)%L,(i+1)%L+L,i+L) for i in range(L)]
 ob=mesh(name,vs,fs,iron,'work15_closed');recalc(ob.data);projected_uv(ob.data);bars.append(ob.name)
for j,a in enumerate([3.85,6.25]):
 b=a+1.2
 for k,x in enumerate([1.67,2.23]):
  tbar('W15 glazing tee %d %d'%(j,k),Vector((x,a,6.975-.52*x)),Vector((x,b,6.975-.52*x)),S)
 y=(a+b)/2
 tbar('W15 glazing cross tee '+str(j),Vector((1.09,y,6.975-.52*1.09)),Vector((2.81,y,6.975-.52*2.81)),Y)
craft['work15_roof']=True
bpy.context.view_layer.update()

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
